# HAX at Penn State

> HAX is Penn State's free, open-source website builder. Students, faculty and staff can publish accessible course sites, portfolios and project sites with no coding required.

This is the full text of the hax.psu.edu homepage as Markdown, for AI assistants and other clients that do not run JavaScript. Canonical page: https://hax.psu.edu/. A shorter link map is at https://hax.psu.edu/llms.txt.

The HAX network

## One door into everything HAX

hax.psu.edu is where Penn State builds. The rest of the HAX network is open to everyone: why HAX, the brain behind it, tutorials, every block, and the art that started it all.

- [**HAX at Penn State** hax.psu.edu · you are here Log in with your Penn State account and build. Hosted, supported and governed by Penn State.](https://hax.psu.edu/#top)
- [**HAXTheWeb** haxtheweb.org Why HAX is for you, and every way to get it.](https://haxtheweb.org/)
- [**PRAW** hax.cloud The brain of the HAX ecosystem: every person, pillar and project, and how they connect.](https://hax.cloud/)
- [**Learn** learn.hax.cloud Tutorials that teach HAX one flow at a time.](https://learn.hax.cloud/)
- [**Lab** lab.hax.cloud HAX Lab: where students and junior developers learn by shipping real HAX work.](https://lab.hax.cloud/)
- [**Web components** webcomponents.hax.cloud Every HAX element, with live demos and walkthroughs.](https://webcomponents.hax.cloud/)
- [**Art** art.hax.cloud The HAX art movement: posters, the Future Traveler across time, and playful tools like RPG me.](https://art.hax.cloud/)

HAX Lab

## Don't just use it. Build it.

HAX Lab is where students and contributors build HAX itself, through courses, independent studies, internships and clubs. What you make ships to hundreds of real sites, with your name on it.

### Drop in to open office hours

Online every Monday, Wednesday and Friday, noon to 4 p.m. Eastern. Many contributors start here without ever taking a class.

[Join the Discord](https://discord.gg/aCGxmRHEJP)

### Independent study or internship

Build a real feature that ships to hundreds of sites. Alumni now work at Red Hat, Adobe, IBM, Ford and PennDOT.

[Meet HAX Lab](https://lab.hax.cloud/)

### Bring your club

Security, UX, design: student clubs bring their own passion and HAX gives them a real problem to work on.

[See what clubs did](https://hax.cloud/stories/1eb915c8)

### Faculty: fund a student project

Faculty fund students to solve their own teaching problems, and HAX gains a capability everyone can use.

[See faculty grants](https://hax.cloud/stories/59022035)

Mon · Wed · Fri

Noon to 4 p.m. ET

**Open office hours, online.** Drop in with a question, an idea or a bug and leave with something shipped.

Want to come in person? Ask in the Discord.

[Join the HAX Discord](https://discord.gg/aCGxmRHEJP)

Student success

## Students who shipped it

Each character below is drawn from the student's own name, the same way HAX draws you when you log in.

### Jimmy Kane

Led the four-student team that built the first Site Dashboard in one semester, the work HAX's 8-bit characters come from. Now an iOS engineer at Ford Motor Credit.

[See the story](https://hax.cloud/stories/ee450a19)

### Zach Dodson

Built a HAX and AI proof of concept, then sent a pull request adding a design system audit to the HAX CLI. It was part of the class within weeks.

[See the story](https://hax.cloud/stories/a3d9550d)

### Winston White

Took IST 256 in 2024, then built themes, much of the HAX CLI and skeleton templating, and TA'd the class. Now in site reliability at IBM.

[See the story](https://hax.cloud/stories/325e6281)

Watch: [HAX Lab student story](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Db3PnqPAFjw)

Watch: [HAX Lab student story, part two](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=q8mbsiiwMCE)

### What they did, and what you can do

Jimmy, Zach and Winston started where you are: a class, an office hours visit, a question. Each one shipped something real that people use every day, and took that experience into their careers.

**Your turn.** Bring an idea, a bug or just curiosity to open office hours, and leave with something shipped.

[Join the HAX Discord](https://discord.gg/aCGxmRHEJP)

[See the story: From HAX Lab to industry on hax.cloud](https://hax.cloud/stories/1cc711b1)

- [More student stories on haxtheweb.org](https://haxtheweb.org/community)
- [How HAX Lab keeps HAX going: the SIIP pipeline](https://haxtheweb.org/community)

Institutional goals

## From the college, to the Commonwealth, to the planet

HAX starts with the goals of the College of Arts and Architecture. Meeting them builds skills, partnerships and open tools that reach far past campus, into every corner of Pennsylvania. And because we build the technology the right way, the same work helps build a better planet. Every claim links to its evidence on hax.cloud.

- [The college](https://hax.psu.edu/#goals-college)
- [The Commonwealth](https://hax.psu.edu/#goals-psu)
- [The planet](https://hax.psu.edu/#goals-planet)

### College of Arts and Architecture Strategic Plan 2030

HAX meets 14 of the plan's objectives, across all five of its goals.

#### Build a culture of collaboration

- Shared spaces and systems that encourage collaboration (1A)
- Cross-disciplinary collaboration in curricula, research and practice (1B)
- Collaboration that reduces administrative burden (1C)

[Story: Build a culture of collaboration, on hax.cloud](https://hax.cloud/stories/d83bb4ec)

#### Amplify our responsibility as a cultural bridge

- Student experiential opportunities (2B)
- Human-centered design in courses and creative practice (2C)
- A&A's visibility and partnerships, state to global (2D)

[Story: Amplify our responsibility as a cultural bridge, on hax.cloud](https://hax.cloud/stories/342ec276)

#### Empower learners to build the future

- Diverse career pathways through experiential learning (3A)
- Ethical AI literacy and future-ready skills (3B)
- Creativity and emerging technology for all students (3C)
- New learning models that match workforce needs (3D)

[Story: Empower learners to build the future, on hax.cloud](https://hax.cloud/stories/71ac19ae)

#### Champion arts and design as research and practice

- Cross-campus partnerships that raise arts and design's impact (4A)
- Recognition of A&A's creative activity and scholarship (4B)
- Human-centered use of AI in creative practice (4C)

[Story: Champion arts and design as research and practice, on hax.cloud](https://hax.cloud/stories/cad05bce)

#### Cultivate an equitable community for all

- Remove affordability and access barriers (5B)

[Story: Cultivate an equitable community for all, on hax.cloud](https://hax.cloud/stories/e6680a54)

[See the story: Tour: how HAX meets A&A's plan on hax.cloud](https://hax.cloud/tours/a-and-a-strategic-plan-2030-how-hax-meets-a-and-a-s-plan)

[Read the A&A Strategic Plan 2030](https://arts.psu.edu/about/aa-strategic-plan-2030)

### Meeting the college's goals improves the Commonwealth

What HAX does for the college carries into Penn State's strategic plan and its land-grant promise to Pennsylvania.

#### Enhancing Student Success

Mentoring and class experiences that carry students into careers, student clubs working on a real product, and the Learn to Flourish Hub's focus on wellness.

[Story: Enhancing Student Success, on hax.cloud](https://hax.cloud/stories/c319d900)

#### Increasing Land-Grant Impact

Partnerships with industry, nonprofits and communities: open packages used around the world, HAX Camp, and the faculty and donors behind the Learn to Flourish Hub.

[Story: Increasing Land-Grant Impact, on hax.cloud](https://hax.cloud/stories/bc2c7d84)

#### Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging

Closing outcome gaps by removing barriers: a $250 textbook became a $30 fee, and pages stay fast on any device.

[Story: Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging, on hax.cloud](https://hax.cloud/stories/55149bcc)

[See the story: How HAX meets Penn State's plan on hax.cloud](https://hax.cloud/penn-state/strategic-plan)

[Read Penn State's strategic plan](https://strategicplan.psu.edu/)

### Building technology the right way builds a better planet

Accessible, open and efficient by design, HAX meets 7 of the 17 UN Sustainable Development Goals. We only list the goals we have evidence for.

#### Quality Education (Goal 4)

Accessible and open by default; students learn by building a real product.

[Story: Quality Education, on hax.cloud](https://hax.cloud/stories/0b18f2ea)

#### Affordable and Clean Energy (Goal 7)

Less energy per page: web standards, offline-capable sites, services that run only when called.

[Story: Affordable and Clean Energy, on hax.cloud](https://hax.cloud/stories/60ba266e)

#### Decent Work and Economic Growth (Goal 8)

Real-product experience that carries into industry.

[Story: Decent Work and Economic Growth, on hax.cloud](https://hax.cloud/stories/a67c966c)

#### Industry, Innovation and Infrastructure (Goal 9)

Hundreds of open web components and packages others reuse.

[Story: Industry, Innovation and Infrastructure, on hax.cloud](https://hax.cloud/stories/04fbf8b9)

#### Reduced Inequalities (Goal 10)

Works for everyone, on any device, whatever their ability.

[Story: Reduced Inequalities, on hax.cloud](https://hax.cloud/stories/b66a6c30)

#### Responsible Consumption and Production (Goal 12)

Content outlives redesigns, so nothing gets rebuilt.

[Story: Responsible Consumption and Production, on hax.cloud](https://hax.cloud/stories/808a5b5a)

#### Partnerships for the Goals (Goal 17)

Colleges, foundations, companies and students build it together.

[Story: Partnerships for the Goals, on hax.cloud](https://hax.cloud/stories/e6c6907b)

[See the story: The UN goals HAX meets on hax.cloud](https://hax.cloud/un-sdgs)

FAQ

## Questions

### Who can use hax.psu.edu?

Anyone with a Penn State account: [log in](https://hax.psu.edu/login.php) and start building. HAX itself is free and open source, so anyone outside Penn State can get it from [haxtheweb.org](https://haxtheweb.org/).

### How are decisions made?

By the people who use it: students, faculty and staff who take or build courses with HAX. The Core Product Development team meets monthly and is open to any group contributing development, design or other skills. To join, contact [Bill Rose, Product Owner](mailto:bmr1@psu.edu) (bmr1@psu.edu).

### Why was HAX created?

A university Request for Information sought a custom instructional content management system. The requirements went far beyond what any vendor offered and no vendor answered the request for proposal, so Penn State built a new kind of solution.

[See the story: Where HAX came from on hax.cloud](https://hax.cloud/history)

### Privacy and policy

Penn State IT does not monitor websites and does not assume responsibility for published content; authors are responsible for their own sites. Use of this service is governed by [Penn State policies and guidelines](https://security.psu.edu/awareness/psu-policies/), including the [IT Web Services Policy](https://policy.psu.edu/policies/ad54). All pages must comply with [Accessibility Standards, Policy AD69](https://policies.psu.edu/policies/ad69).
